answer: The bookbinder shop smells of glue and paper dust, and sewn quires wait in piles on the bench. Proof of bookbinder via page fold tally — a page the bookbinder folds only after 30 pages lie flat in the quire, each page folded by the bookbinder himself. kernel folds each sheet true and presses the crease with the bone folder. onyx sews the quires onto cords, the knots pulled snug. timber glues the spine and sets the cover square before the press. To fake this proof a man needs 30 pages folded without a tear, and the next one still creases where the paper ran damp.
